bound_interpretation.callback_observed_bounds: bounds and solver_bounds are callback-observed diagnostics, not final post-optimise solver status
bound_interpretation.lower_bound: best bound from Gurobi callback best_bound
bound_interpretation.runtime_seconds: Gurobi callback runtime only; excludes fragment preprocessing
bound_interpretation.upper_bound: best incumbent objective from Gurobi callback best_obj

interpretation.callback_solver_bounds: see solver_bounds for callback-observed diagnostic bounds
interpretation.obj_bound: final best bound read after model.optimize() returns
interpretation.obj_val: final incumbent objective read after model.optimize() returns
interpretation.status_name: best-effort name for final solver Status code

reporting_bounds.interpretation: Final post-optimise solver attributes for reporting tables; callback diagnostics remain in callback_observed_bounds and solver_bounds.

reporting_note: For tables, use solve_status_summary or reporting_bounds. The legacy bounds and solver_bounds fields are callback-observed diagnostics.
